hashConvention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 LF source. Pester extents include indentation and final LF. Workflow step extents run from the name through the blank line before the next step.

selectors.reviewScope: Rejects unavailable, cancelled, empty, partial and errored evaluations. It also checks exact threshold equality, the transport-only threshold and rounding boundaries.

selectors.selector: records a case error for empty <Backend> output
selectors.reviewScope: The real module dispatcher reports whitespace-only HTTP or Ollama replies as errors. The HTTP case requires the expected ordered completion and chat fallback calls.
The healthy loopback mock has to complete a real inference case without a case error. Threshold zero keeps the fixture focused on transport.

selectors.selector: Verify failed evaluation leaves its report
selectors.reviewScope: Healthy mock readiness is followed by a completion error. The actual CLI must exit nonzero and the report must retain the CaseErrors verdict and counts.
